      About this item

      • AMPLE STORAGE: With a 4L capacity, this electric cooler can store up to 6 cans of your favorite beverages or snacks, keeping them chilled and ready to enjoy.
      • FLEXIBILE USAGE: Ideal for storing drinks, skincare, snacks, and more, this compact mini fridge comes in an assortment of stylish colors to fit your unique aesthetic and use.
      • GAMERS DELIGHT: Add flair and convenience to your gaming experience with this compact mini cooler with brilliant LED colored lights that will complete your space.
      • SKINCARE COOLER: You can also use the interior space of this countertop mini fridge for skincare products and beauty tools, offering a refreshing twist to your daily routine.
      • PORTABLE & SECURE: Compact and portable with a convenient carrying handle, this mini fridge cooler is perfect for on-the-go use, weighing only 3lbs. With a heavy-duty locking latch and door hinge, your items will stay securely stored wherever you take it.
      • VERSTAILE POWER OPTIONS: Equipped with cords for both a 12V car adapter and a home outlet, this cooler fridge offers flexible power options, ensuring you can use it wherever you go.
      • EFFICIENT COOLING: Utilizing a thermoelectric cooling system, this retro cooler operates quietly and efficiently, cooling drinks to 26-28 degrees Fahrenheit below ambient room temperature for refreshing enjoyment.
      • Note: The extent of cooling achieved by this small fridge cooler may vary based on the surrounding environment.

      How customer reviews and ratings work

      Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      Customers say

      Customers give positive feedback about the mini refrigerator's appearance and capacity, noting it can hold 6 cans or two large bottles. However, the cooling performance and functionality receive mixed reviews - while some say it works great for cooling drinks, others report it overheats and the lights stop working after a week. Moreover, the build quality and durability are concerning, with multiple customers reporting it breaking after 2 months or dying after a year of use. Additionally, customers find the noise level very loud, and the size receives mixed reactions, with some appreciating its compact design while others find it extremely small.

      • Texaschikkita
        1.0 out of 5 stars DO. NOT. BUY.
        Reviewed in the United States on July 25, 2024
        Color: WhiteVerified Purchase
        This has to be one of the worst purchases ever. Bought one and I bought it open box. There are times I’ve ordered something. I realize it doesn’t fit or match or I don’t like it and returned it in brand new condition. When I saw the fridge open box for half off, I thought cool. Someone got it it didn’t work for their space and they returned it. I trusted that Amazon did their due diligence.

        Package arrives. Open it plug it in. It worked for 5 seconds and then the lights turned white. No color. That was it.

        OK, I figured well that was an open box fail. So I returned it purchased a new one.

        Opened the box to the new one. Plugged it in. It lit up. Great.

        Keep in mind this is for a seven-year-old so I wasn’t expecting anything fancy

        However, this thing is such a piece of junk

        You have to use two hands to close it Literally. You have to hold the back while you shut the door.

        It has no temp control. So it goes from barely cooling to forming icicles and freezer burn around the back of the fridge.

        It’s LOUD. It sounds like you’re inflating an air mattress. The only way to make it shut up is to unplug it. Then it doesn’t actually work as a fridge.

        Whatever. The little one sleeps on a loft bunk so the noise didn’t bother him. When I would tuck him in, I would have to unplug it because I couldn’t take the noise then I would just plug it in before I left the room.

        Then after 10 days it stopped working entirely.
        No LED lights. No cooling.

        However, the noise never stopped. No lights. No cooling. Just sound

        So it’s just basically a very cheaply made noise machine that sounds like your blowing up inflatables with an air machine.

        Honestly, honestly, I can’t imagine spending more than five dollars on this and using it for an evening and throwing it away.

        I can’t believe this is made by Frigidaire. It’s such a horribly made product.

        It’s just junk. Dollhouse furniture is constructed better.

        You can’t use this for anything besides a power hog and noise. According to my smart plug it used massive power. lol. For what??

        Honestly. Do. Not. Buy. Next.

        You’re welcome.

      • Michael S.
        3.0 out of 5 stars It's fine, but a little cheap
        Reviewed in the United States on June 10, 2025
        Color: PurplehazeVerified Purchase
        This is actually the second one I bought after a mishap on my end damaged the first

        Potential buyers would be best to keep their expectations tempered. The size and power consumption would suggest that, no, it's not going to chill what is put inside it. Rather, it'll get it cold. Perhaps accumulate some condensation from what's put into it

        Update: after leaving it to run as I normally do, nothing on the inside has been cooled. I'm thinking the issue has to do with the power supply as the fan is still running, but the lack of LEDs and the cooling mechanism would suggest to me something went wrong. I think if I threw this at someone a little more mechanically inclined than I am, they'd probably find that a single cable needs to be replaced. As it were though, and for as cheap as this thing is, I have decided it'd be best to just replace it with another one that has the features I wanted in the first place.

        I bought this at a time that I believed this was the only thing like it on the market. I'm a sucker for 'raging gaming baby' lights and wanted more clown vomit in my eyes with my borderline diabetic consumption of soft drinks.

        The infinity mirror effect it has is nice. The LEDs, however, are static. They do not shift or change colors

        There is a LED light on the inside that never turns off, and a window in the middle of the mirror. While the window does let you monitor the contents of the cooler... it takes away from the infinity mirror effect

        I haven't tinkered too much with the thing, but with a little ingenuity you may be able to mod the cooler. The front panel, as noted in other reviews, can be removed. Some units coming off on their own, like my first one. I would imagine that the wiring is rather simple through the door hinge into the LEDs. The back of the unit is where you'll find the cooling device and the fan that's meant to dissipate the heat. You WILL want to remove the back panel carefully if you ever intend to clear out the unit of any dust, dirt, and hair

        Over a year later, this review was prompted by the LEDs just... going out on their own. Power indicator lights are also gone. I can't say if anything else has fried. I also can't say for sure if this also isn't some issue incurred on my end as I had recently plugged the fridge into a smart plug to help curb the power bill, and have pretty much kept it running with the majority that I've owned it. I'll keep it going for as long as it'll go up until I replace it with another unit that has LEDs and an infinity mirror more to my liking. You can get way better than this just on LED features alone now. Not sure if I can say it was good value for my money, but I can say I didn't regret buying it.
